messages:
maya: heads-up — bringing up argo-13b (int8) on canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs and elevated memory fragmentation on long prompts :thinking:

Tariq: can you paste the process logs / alloc trace?

maya: paste:
```
[2026-03-15T16:02:12Z] GPU0 alloc failed: requested 1.2GB, free 820MB
[2026-03-15T16:02:12Z] fragmentation: free_regions=3 largest_free=820MB total_free=1.6GB
killed process main (OOM)
```

jess: is this with max_new_tokens=1024 and batch=8? those defaults push peak for 13b models.

maya: yes, default 1024 / batch 8.

jess: try lowering max_new_tokens -> 512 and default batch -> 4. also enable kv_compact and disable aggressive prefetch for int8. we've seen frag reduce ~30%.

samir: quick command to test locally:
```
redwood run --model argo-13b --quant int8 --max_new_tokens 512 --batch_size 4 \
  --runtime-opt kv_compact=true --runtime-opt kv_prefetch=0
```

infra-bot: canary deploy scheduled (id: canary-argo-2167895000) — argo-13b-int8 with runtime tweaks

maya: spun canary, ran 2000 requests with longform-sanity prompts. no OOMs so far, memory fragmentation metric dropped from 0.47 -> 0.32. latency ~ +8% median.

jess: expected. note quality may regress with int8 at smaller max_new_tokens because of decoding context change. run evals on 'summaries' and 'longform-sanity' prompt sets.

maya: ran eval quick pass: ROUGE-L down 1.8%, P@1 down 1.1%. will run full harness overnight and open an artifact.

samir: if quality drop unacceptable, try per-layer scale calibration (calib=layerwise) or fallback policy: route >512 tokens to int4 or fullfp pipelines.

jess: also consider a gradual rollout with slowstart (30s ramp) and metric monitor on mem-frag + p99 latency.

maya: action items: I'll upload evals + perf numbers and a proposed rollout config. tariq/samir to validate kv_compact and scheduling for defrag restarts. tagging followups in PR.

tariq: noted, will add a short CI check to flag fragmentation >0.4 on canaries.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
